title: The Box Fort
skill_description: Practice reading CVC words with short vowels (a, e, i, o, u) in a familiar setting.
author: FunBookies
summary: Max wants to build a fort from a big box. He adds a mat, a pad on top, and cuts a window. But his little sister Mika keeps climbing in before he is done! In the end they both squeeze in and it is the best fort.
visual_style: Warm gouache watercolor with soft afternoon light. Cozy indoor living room — wooden floor, colorful rug, couch in background. Cardboard box as the centerpiece. Domestic warmth and gentle humor.

reference_prompt:
9-panel children's book reference sheet, warm gouache watercolor style with soft afternoon light.

Row 1 - CHARACTERS:
[1] Max front view: boy (6), sandy brown messy hair, round face, blue t-shirt, grey shorts, barefoot. Standing confidently holding a cardboard flap.
[2] Mika front view: toddler girl (2), dark curly hair in two small pigtails, chubby cheeks, big grin, purple shirt, green leggings, barefoot. Holding a stuffed bear.
[3] Max and Mika together: Max standing tall, Mika reaching up to him. Size difference clear — she comes up to his waist.

Row 2 - KEY ELEMENTS:
[4] Large cardboard box: plain brown corrugated cardboard, open on one side, big enough for both kids. Square window hole cut in one side.
[5] **HERO SHOT**: Both kids inside the box fort — cushion roof, red mat floor, cup and bag inside, their bare feet sticking out one end. Warm golden light filtering through gaps. Cozy.
[6] The box fort from outside: box on colorful striped rug, beige couch cushion on top as roof, square window cut in side, stuffed bear peeking out. Living room background.

Row 3 - SETTINGS:
[7] Living room wide view: wooden floor, colorful striped rug, beige couch, window with afternoon sunlight, houseplants. Warm domestic scene.
[8] Inside the box: view from inside looking out through the square window. Red mat on floor, warm golden light, cardboard walls around. Cozy den feeling.
[9] Props collection: red mat/blanket, beige couch cushion, small blue cup, cloth bag, brown stuffed bear. Arranged on white background.

Palette: warm cardboard brown, blue (Max's shirt), purple (Mika's shirt), red mat, beige cushion, wooden floor gold. Warm afternoon tones throughout.
Format: Square 1:1, 3x3 grid, thin white borders between panels.
CRITICAL: NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS anywhere in the image.

parent_tips.before_reading: Look at the cover together. Ask: What are they inside? What did they use to build it? Have you ever made a fort?
parent_tips.during_reading: Point to each item Max adds. Ask: What did he put in next? Why did Mika get in? Is Max happy or upset?
parent_tips.after_reading: Talk about building forts together. What would you put in your fort? Could you build one right now with a box or blankets?

comprehension_questions.question: What did Max put in the box?
comprehension_questions.answer: A red mat, his cup and bag.

comprehension_questions.question: What did Mika do?
comprehension_questions.answer: She ran to the box and got in before Max was done.

comprehension_questions.question: What did Max cut in the box?
comprehension_questions.answer: A gap (window) so he can see out.

comprehension_questions.question: Did they both fit?
comprehension_questions.answer: Yes, but it was a tight fit! They had fun.
